Domestic HRC prices hold at Rs 52,000 a tonne

Domestic hot rolled coil (HRC) prices were quoted at Rs 52,000 per tonne on 28 October 2026, unchanged from the previous week as mills held their list prices.

SAIL had cut prices of hot-rolled coils by Rs 500/t to Rs 50,500/t earlier this month, its third reduction of the season.

Traders expect the market to stay range-bound until the next round of list-price changes, while the Baltic Dry Index moved 1.2% higher to 1,850 points on Wednesday.
